bearerAuth.description: Opaque local token or verified OIDC access JWT; ID tokens are rejected.

version.description: Nonnegative decimal string; server validates signed bigint bound.

socialStats.description: Counts of active persisted relationships, excluding inactive and blocked accounts. Omitted from visitor profiles unless allowed.

SelfProfile.description: Own profile fields only. ETag is the quoted version; username normalized lowercase ASCII while display name supports Unicode.

avatarMediaId.description: Uploads are not implemented; clearing a reference is allowed.

coverMediaId.description: Uploads are not implemented; clearing a reference is allowed.

languages.description: Structured language entries. Legacy tag strings remain accepted without inferred proficiency.

version.description: Nonnegative decimal string; server validates signed bigint bound.

socialStats.description: Counts of active persisted relationships, excluding inactive and blocked accounts. Omitted from visitor profiles unless allowed.

locked.description: True when the profile audience excludes the viewer. A locked card carries only identity, style and relationship.

PublicProfile.description: Viewer-specific projection. Optional fields are omitted when hidden. Counts are bounded/projection-safe and never reveal private graph memberships.

friendRequestId.description: Present while a request is pending, so the client can accept or cancel it.

ciphertext.description: Unpadded base64 Olm ciphertext, at most 16 KiB decoded

envelopes.description: Exactly one per active device of the peer and of the sender other than senderDeviceId; otherwise 409 DEVICES_CHANGED
